ns2:section.sectionText: This course examines American Indian encounters with Christianity from the late 1400s to the present. By incorporating primary and secondary sources, this course seeks to explore the ways in which Christianity was used both as a method of colonization, and religious transformation. Topics covered in the course will include Native rejection and acceptance of Christianity, religious and philosophical tensions between Native communities and Christian missionaries, and the many complexities that exist when people from diverse religious cultures intersect
